about: baby-sienna citation contract, version 2. bs.py check reads it and hard-codes none of it: the closed citation types, each source kind's inputs, locator grammar and printed label, the citation rules per element category, where web sources may be cited, the AI terms, and the three provenance-line forms of a document. Id patterns and enums live in the schemas. formats/FORMATS.md explains this file and does not restate it. Every regex is valid in Python re and in ECMAScript.

sheet.label: Workbook
sheet.order: sheets in workbook order, then row, then column

document.label: Document
document.order: page, then paragraph: a file with pages numbers paragraphs within each page, a file without pages through the whole file

system.note: map-8: its label occurs in a record it cites. Its marker is in the system key; its Citation points row names the system under Used by

system.software.note: inv-1: Named in the sources when a grounded record holds its name; otherwise its inferred reading is the evidence. Printed by Original data received and the systems inventory, not by the board

lane.note: map-3: a lane that holds no step needs a grounded citation for its role. Its marker is in the gutter; its Citation points row names the lane under Used by

node.inferred.note: map-7: the reading printed on the card is at most cardReadingMax characters

node.gap.note: the step exists in the sources; its gap card proves what is missing (map-6)

group.note: no citation: a view is our framing of the board

edge.note: no citation: the nodes at its ends hold the evidence. A branch label's numbers come from a record its decision cites

gap.note: a cited weakness is not a gap: a gap proves with an absent search what the sources do not say; a weakness the sources state is a clarification

clarification.note: the grounded citations are what the sources show

gap.none.note: None found (map-6): the only gap card, listing no step; it cites what shows the sources leave no step out, such as the records that name each step's owner and order

clarification.none.note: None found (map-6): the only clarification card, listing no step; it cites what shows nothing on the map is left to confirm

ai.named.note: ai-3: the client asked for it in their own words, in a source that is not web

ai.suggested.note: our idea, read from the records

sentence.note: through a bracket in the sentence, or a provenance line straight after its block. A Gap line must be PROVEN

module.note: our suggestion, read from the records, like ai.suggested. inv-2 checks its software and steps against the map
